item.description: Settings > Integrations > Websites names the site in your browser's front tab: allow a browser, tick the sites you want named, and friends read "On GitHub" instead of Chrome. Agent minutes now count every session: two agents through an hour are two hours, the way person-hours are. The Leaderboard shows who is online for everyone on it, not only your friends. Settings > Privacy: "Last seen and online" now hides both — with it off nobody sees you online, in the list or in their menu bar. A friend request opens in the panel with the note beside it, to accept or decline there. An update shows its download as a ring on its button, and the panel's card restarts Firstlight itself. Settings rows light evenly, and a group's roster reads at the size the other panels use.

Firstlight no longer crashes on macOS 26.1 when it opens while your last session is being restored. Add friend now asks before sending the request, and you can add a short note that they see beside it.

Opening "want to be friends" from Add a friend no longer freezes the app. The list's Refreshing button no longer stays on after the list has updated. Tray rows now respond to a click anywhere they light up. The onboarding intro keeps playing when you click outside its window. Settings > About > Updates has an "Update automatically" switch. Firstlight now reads only the agent logs it counts, not the settings and sign-in files beside them. The open Leaderboard no longer shows presence dots that made everyone look offline.
